title: Auto Loans: past-due installments, the paying account and the autopay discount at enrollment
content:
# Auto Loans: past-due installments, the paying account and the autopay discount at enrollment

This rule of the Auto Loans product category at PCB applies when a borrower enrolls an auto loan in autopay from one of their PCB checking accounts. It decides whether the autopay discount enters the enrolled APR.

## Condition for the autopay discount

The loan has no installment past due when autopay is enrolled, so the enrollment carries the autopay discount. Where an installment is still past due when the enrollment is recorded, the enrollment carries no autopay discount.

When the loan has an installment past due and the borrower brings it current in the same call, the scheduled payment is posted before the enrollment is recorded, so that the enrollment is recorded on a loan with no installment past due and carries the autopay discount.

## When the autopay discount is added

1. The autopay discount is added at enrollment only when the loan has no installment past due, that is when its days past due are zero, and the paying account is a checking account of the borrower in active status.
2. An enrollment recorded while an installment is past due carries no autopay discount.
3. Re-enrolling after a cancellation restores the autopay discount only on the same terms as a first enrollment: when the loan has no installment past due and the paying account is a checking account of the borrower in active status.

When added, the discount is the product's autopay discount; otherwise the autopay discount counted at enrollment is nothing. The days past due are read from the loan record as they stand when the enrollment is recorded.

## Truth table

| Days past due on the loan record when the enrollment is recorded | Paying account: the borrower's checking account in active status? | Autopay discount counted |
|---|---|---|
| zero | yes | the product's autopay discount |
| zero | no | nothing |
| above zero | yes | nothing |
| above zero | no | nothing |

## Order within one call (hypothetical loan 12 days past due, active paying account)

| Sequence in the same call | Days past due when the enrollment is recorded | Autopay discount |
|---|---|---|
| scheduled payment bringing the installment current posted first, enrollment recorded after | zero | counted |
| enrollment recorded while the installment is still past due | above zero | not counted |

## Points of judgement

**A borrower re-enrolls a month after cancelling; does the discount come back automatically?** Only on the same terms as a first enrollment: no installment past due and an active checking account of the borrower paying.

**The loan is active but one installment is a few days past due, and the borrower will bring it current in this call; what is posted first?** The scheduled payment is posted before the enrollment is recorded, so that the enrollment carries the autopay discount.
